messages.author: 09c30ae12080e229
messages.subject: Buffer question
parts:
In regard to buffer size, I have clustered trap grids (hair snare) where average distance between traps is ~5km and avg distance between clusters is ~10km. Does the buffer need to be increased to account for the clustered design? Using the rule of thumb:

b <- RPSV(bbgrey, CC=T) 
b * 4
> 3892

A retrospective buffer check returns a value of:

suggest.buffer(secrgrey10)
> 9235

A larger buffer covers the area between the clusters as well (i.e. 10,000). I attached example plots of the buffers at 4000 and 10000. Thanks for the help

Ryan

messages.author: 118cea91a1619106
messages.subject: Re: Buffer question
parts: Not sure I understand your issue. Clustering per se does not affect the required buffer width. The question is simply whether the mask is wide enough to include all animals with non-negligible chance of detection. It seems sigma-hat from your fitted model substantially different to the halfnormal RPSV approximation. Use esa.plot or maybe mask.check to evaluate that evaluate that retrospectively (there may be something useful in secr-habitatmasks.pdf).
